name: Divyansh Srivastava
title: Associate Product Manager
facts: Divyansh Srivastava is an Associate Product Manager at Wells Fargo (August 2024 to present).
He works on enterprise CRM products: Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the WalkMe digital adoption platform, plus enterprise data management.

At Wells Fargo he gathers business requirements with cross-functional stakeholders and delivers Salesforce solutions for 20,000+ enterprise users across multiple Lines of Business (IF, VF, EF, ABL, CDF and CF).
At Wells Fargo he runs Salesforce product operations: user management, change requests, data loading, data cleansing, account and contact merges, user queries, reports and dashboards.
He optimized workflows and processes, reducing manual effort by more than 40%, and built KPI dashboards and product performance reports for executive reporting.
By analysing user behaviour, support trends and stakeholder feedback he identified product enhancements that reduced support tickets by 30%.
He is the single point of contact for business support channels and writes application documentation and feature guidance.
He supports product governance and compliance: data quality, metadata standards, issue resolution and JIRA workflows.
He supported data retention and migration initiatives, translating regulatory requirements into product improvements and data controls, and led functional testing and UAT across class codes and orgs.

He led digital adoption with WalkMe across Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Client Insight and other enterprise apps, building SmartTips, Surveys, Shuttles, Walkthroughs and Launchers, and took part in Agile product reviews.

Before Wells Fargo he was a Data Management Analyst at Deloitte (July 2023 to July 2024): data governance standards, data quality analysis, requirements gathering and reporting, using Salesforce (Jupiter), Informatica MDM 360, Crunchbase, D&B Hoovers, Capital IQ, SwiftPad, DESC and TRE Bulk Upload.

Before Deloitte he was a Research Associate at Jasper Colin Research (January 2022 to May 2023), running B2B and consumer market research data collection (CATI and CAWI) for domestic and international clients.

At Jasper Colin he worked on projects in automotive collision, insurance tech, IT education, telecom, FMCG, email security products (SEG, ICES, DMARC, browser isolation), global manufacturing and construction, and US brand equity.
Education: MBA/PGDM in Operations from Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE), 2021, CGPA 9.44 out of 10.

Certifications: How to Use Roadmaps in Jira; Microsoft Power BI Desktop for Business Intelligence; Copilot Studio (Coursera); The Product Owner Profession: Unleashing the Power of Scrum (Skill Up); Prompt Engineering.
Product management skills: roadmap planning, user story writing, UAT, Agile/Scrum, JIRA, product operations, market research and secondary research.
CRM and platforms: Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Dynamics 365, WalkMe, Microsoft Power Apps.
Data and analytics: Power BI, data governance, data lineage, data quality, source-to-target mapping, root cause analysis.
Tools and reporting: KPI reporting, regulatory reporting, Power BI, Excel, prompt engineering.
He has roughly 4+ years of total experience across product, data management and research (since January 2022).
